text:
maya: opened an urgent docs PR to surface the auth outage status link + a short workaround in Known Issues. need a second reviewer and a docs-preview sanity check before we merge to main and backport to stable. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/431

alex: grabbing it now. which statuspage URL should we reference?

maya: using https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-4 — adding a small callout on /docs/known-issues.md and a note in /docs/operational/incident-response.md

sam: saw the PR, one thought: the workaround uses a curl example that assumes token rotation. can we include the new async python snippet instead and keep curl as fallback?

maya: yep, will add both. adding short rationale line that async snippet is recommended for new integrations.

alex: docs-preview failed on MDX parsing for the callout macro (looks like we used markdown link inside the callout). switching to raw link or explicit HTML anchor should fix it.

sam: suggested callout content:

> Incident status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-4

And the async snippet for workaround:

```python
from redwood.async_client import AsyncRedwoodClient

async def try_request():
    client = AsyncRedwoodClient(api_key=\"<REDACTED>\")
    # workaround: exponential backoff on 401 until auth cache rotation completes
    # recommended for new codepaths
    await client.generate(...)
```

Keep the curl example under "legacy clients" heading.

irene: added as reviewer. I'll approve after preview build succeeds and wording gets product sign-off. tagging @leo for product tone.

leo: quick read 10s2 10s2: wording looks customer-friendly. tiny tweak: replace "we are working on" with "we rotated auth cache; users may see transient 401s" so it's concrete. otherwise OK.

maya: applied wording change, pushed. re-ran preview.

preview-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded (preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-431)

irene: approving now. please ensure PR description includes the preview URL and the stable backport plan.

maya: merged to main and backported to stable branch. updated PR description with preview URL and note about the backport (stable branch: release/2026-03). also added a line in internal changelog: "docs hotfix: auth outage status link + workaround (PR #431)"

alex: nice. support notified?

maya: yep pinged #customer-success and added a short blurb to the incident postmortem linking to the docs change and the Statuspage entry.

sam: thanks. I'll open a follow-up to add a short unit test for the docs sample rendering so the MDX parser won't choke on future edits.

maya: good idea. closing thread.
